cases.p: caller is not the configured relayer and invokes rngComplete
cases.i: rng completion implies caller is the configured relayer
cases.v: rng completes while caller is not the configured relayer

cases.p: locking time is not later than opening time at market creation
cases.i: successful creation implies opening time is earlier than locking time
cases.v: market is created with locking time not later than opening time

cases.p: requested collection time is later than current block time
cases.i: completed rent collection implies requested time is no later than current time
cases.v: rent collection completes for a requested future time

cases.p: user supplies a maximum sum for a batch rental
cases.i: completed rental implies actual sum is at most the supplied maximum
cases.v: rental completes with actual sum greater than the supplied maximum

cases.p: restricted user takes the cross-chain composer deposit path
cases.i: completed staking or minting implies the user is not restricted
cases.v: restricted user completes the deposit and receives the cross-chain position
